shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: For 2027, Junior and Senior High study Mark, plus First, Second and Third John, and Jude.

graphics.title: 2027 MATERIAL
graphics.subtitle: MARK · 1, 2, 3 JOHN · JUDE · KJV

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Elementary studies Mark. King James Version only.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Each school brings one team per division. That's two to five quizzers, plus two subs.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Elementary is fourth through sixth grade. Junior High is seventh and eighth. Senior High is ninth through twelfth.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: One official coach sits with the team. And if someone's missing when you're called, you still quiz.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Early rounds can have three teams in one match.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: The Quizmaster reads a question. The first quizzer to light up answers. You get ten seconds to start, and thirty to finish.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: A right answer is twenty points. Senior High games run to fifteen correct answers. Elementary and Junior High run to ten.

graphics.title: HOW A GAME WORKS
graphics.subtitle: +20 RIGHT · TOSS-UP · FREE QUESTION +10
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Miss it, and the question goes to the other teams as a toss-up.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Graphic: simple scoreboard

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Miss that, and there's a free question worth ten, with no penalty.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Graphic: simple scoreboard

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Get four right, or five in Senior High, and you quiz out. A sub comes in.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Graphic: simple scoreboard

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Make four errors, or five in Senior High, and you're out too.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Graphic: simple scoreboard

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Your team's first three errors are free. After that, every error costs ten points.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 6: Graphic: simple scoreboard

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: On finish-the-verse questions, it's word for word. One word added, missing or swapped is an error.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: On reference questions, you can put it in your own words. Quoting the verse word for word there is an error.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Captains get three challenges a game, or four in Senior High.
